A Compliance Management Information System (CMIS) is a comprehensive digital system which supports all aspects of an organisation’s regulatory, compliance, quality management. It is made up of a number of different modules and functionalities, each one enables the user to carry out a specific type of activity, e.g. document management, non-conformance or audit actions. Using a CMIS allows a proactive rather than reactive approach to managing processes, as a result of improved document management and communications of related tasks. A CMIS solution is required to support, at a minimum, the development, configuration, integration, migration, management, review, analysis and reporting of data relating to quality and patient safety activities.</cbc:Description> <cbc:ProcurementTypeCode listID="ProjectType" listAgencyID="EU-COM-OP" listVersionID="1.0">SERVICES</cbc:ProcurementTypeCode> <cac:MainCommodityClassification> <cbc:ItemClassificationCode>72200000</cbc:ItemClassificationCode> </cac:MainCommodityClassification> <cac:MainCommodityClassification> <cbc:ItemClassificationCode> 72210000</cbc:ItemClassificationCode> </cac:MainCommodityClassification> <cac:MainCommodityClassification> <cbc:ItemClassificationCode> 72212170</cbc:ItemClassificationCode> </cac:MainCommodityClassification> <cac:MainCommodityClassification> <cbc:ItemClassificationCode> 48170000</cbc:ItemC

Het indienen van een gemeenschappelijke offerte door meerdere geselecteerde kandidaten zal toegestaan worden. Elke opdracht zal uiteindelijk gesloten worden met de best gerangschikte inschrijver op basis van de gunningscriteria die opgenomen zullen zijn in elke opdracht geplaatst op basis van dit kwalificatiesysteem. In overeenstemming met artikel 148, §5 van de wet van 17 juni 2016 betreffende de overheidsopdrachten behoudt de N.V. TUC RAIL het recht om, diegenen die zullen worden uitgenodigd om een offerte in te dienen, te selecteren onder de gekwalificeerde kandidaten. The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. A full audit trail is kept of all access to the Postbox and a complete record of all supplier submissions is stored. Please note: Before you can use the postbox you must record your interest in a notice. In the case of a Quick Quote or the second stage of a dual stage procedure you must have been invited by the buyer to submit a response. Postbox Response Workspace All postbox re

A Compliance Management Information System (CMIS) is a comprehensive digital system which supports all aspects of an organisation’s regulatory, compliance, quality management. It is made up of a number of different modules and functionalities, each one enables the user to carry out a specific type of activity, e.g. document management, non-conformance or audit actions. Using a CMIS allows a proactive rather than reactive approach to managing processes, as a result of improved document management and communications of related tasks. A CMIS solution is required to support, at a minimum, the development, configuration, integration, migration, management, review, analysis and reporting of data relating to quality and patient safety activities.</cbc:Description> <cbc:ProcurementTypeCode listID="ProjectType" listAgencyID="EU-COM-OP" listVersionID="1.0">SERVICES</cbc:ProcurementTypeCode> <cac:MainCommodityClassification> <cbc:ItemClassificationCode>72200000</cbc:ItemClassificationCode> </cac:MainCommodityClassification> <cac:MainCommodityClassification> <cbc:ItemClassificationCode> 72210000</cbc:ItemClassificationCode> </cac:MainCommodityClassification> <cac:MainCommodityClassification> <cbc:ItemClassificationCode> 72212170</cbc:ItemClassificationCode> </cac:MainCommodityClassification> <cac:MainCommodityClassification> <cbc:ItemClassificationCode> 48170000</cbc:ItemC

deliverables_scope.text: ensten Pour le recrutement de services de consultance Selectieleidraad Kwalificatiesysteem HRXX200001 Rev.4 Guide de sélection Système de qualification HRXX200001 Rév. 4 © TUC RAIL 2/9 © TUC RAIL 2/9 1 ALGEMENE KENMERKEN VAN HET KWALIFICATIESYSTEEM 1 CARACTÉRISTIQUES GÉNÉRALES DU SYSTÈME DE QUALIFICATION 1.1 Beschrijving kwalificatiesysteem 1.1 Description du système de qualification Kwalificatiesysteem voor het werven van consultancy diensten (Engineering, ICT, Finance, HR, …) met behulp van resultaat- of middelenverbintenissen voor interne noden en/of noden van haar klanten op korte- en lange termijn voor opdrachten in zowel het binnenland als in het buitenland. The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. A full audit trail is kept of all access to the Postbox and a complete record of all supplier submissions is stored. Please note: Before you can use the postbox you must record your interest in a notice.
